# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 19 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Seth and Eve Reach Paradise's Gate

---

**19:1** Seth and Eve arrived at the gate of paradise and saw Michael the archangel standing there, guarding the gate.

**19:2** Seth asked Michael for the oil of mercy: 'I beg you, give me the oil of mercy to anoint my father Adam, who is sick and near death.'

**19:3** Michael answered Seth: 'I tell you truly, Seth, I cannot give you what you ask. It is not destined for you in this generation.'

**19:4** 'But when five thousand five hundred years have been fulfilled, the Son of God — the most loving Christ — will come down to earth and resurrect the body of Adam and with him the bodies of all the dead.'

**19:5** 'Then the Son of God will be baptized in the Jordan, and when he comes out of the water, he will anoint with the oil of mercy all who believe in him — and this oil of mercy will be for those who are raised from the dead in his generation.'

---
*SOPHIA: consensus rendering. Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
